args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was unhealthy, while v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were the last healthy production releases.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed health checks after v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the deployed version history entry, but production is now on the healthy v2.3.0. The incident is open for follow-up investigation into what caused v2.3.1 to fail.
